name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching local rally events in Serbia. He honed his skills through years of experience, starting as a freelance journalist covering regional races before transitioning into public relations. Nikola believes in crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. His meticulous approach to media relations and his ability to forge strong relationships within the motorsport community make him a valuable asset.

He has worked with several successful racing teams in various motorsport disciplines, including Formula racing and GT endurance racing. He is adept at managing crises, maximizing media exposure, and cultivating a positive public image for the teams and drivers he represents. Nikola is known for his strategic thinking and proactive communication skills. 

Nikola is very dedicated, and approaches every project with the same intense energy. He has become known for his attention to detail, and for being a good media partner that is always there to provide the resources needed.

physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Insists on having at least one cup of strong Serbian coffee before any major press event.
Secretly practices his acceptance speech for a fictional PR award.
